verdict.rationale: Kino AI is an agent-driven video editor that exposes an MCP server to external agents, so per-skill documentation of what each capability does and when it activates is a fair question for it. However, the evidence pack never mentions skills, tool descriptions or activation conditions. The MCP server, templates and llms.txt material concerns other capabilities and does not transfer to this story.

support.subject: As a developer, every skill documents what it does and when it activates, so I can predict my agent's new behavior before it surprises me
